name: corpnet-synthetic-corpus
description: Synthetic SharePoint pages and Word documents for the CorpNet search proof of concept.

scripts.generate:expansion: node build-expansion.cjs && node generate-documents.cjs --content expansion-content.json --manifest expansion-documents-manifest.json --documents expansion-documents
scripts.generate:paging: node build-paging.cjs && node generate-documents.cjs --content paging-content.json --manifest paging-documents-manifest.json --documents paging-documents
scripts.generate:scale: node build-scale.cjs && node generate-documents.cjs --content scale-content.json --manifest scale-documents-manifest.json --documents scale-documents
